name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
summary: A National Mission for Financial Inclusion providing universal banking services for every unbanked household, including basic savings bank account, need based credit, remittances facility, insurance and pension.
benefits: Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account with no minimum balance, free RuPay debit card with accident insurance cover of Rs.2 lakhs (Rs 1 lakh for accounts opened before 28.08.2018), overdraft facility upto Rs. 10,000/-.
benefits_evidence: Any Indian citizen eligible to open a regular bank account can open a BSBDA. Such an account does not require any minimum balance maintenance.
Under PMJDY, a free Rupay debit card, with inbuilt accident insurance cover of Rs.2 lakhs (Rs 1 lakh for accounts opened before 28.08.2018), is issued to all beneficiaries.
Under PMJDY, beneficiaries can avail OD facility upto Rs. 10,000/-.

unmapped_criteria.criterion: The applicant should be an Indian National
unmapped_criteria.evidence: The applicant should be an Indian National.

unmapped_criteria.criterion: Minors above ten years require support from their legal guardians for administering their PMJDY account
unmapped_criteria.evidence: If minors above ten years apply, they will require support from their legal guardians for administering their PMJDY account.

how_to_apply: Go to the official portal of PMJDY, download and print the Account Opening Form from the e-documents section, fill it manually with bank and personal data, and submit it at the nearest bank branch along with documents and Mobile number or email Id.
how_to_apply_evidence: Step 1- Go to the official portal of PMJDY.
Step 2- Under the "e-documents" section, you will find live links for "Account Opening Form". Applicants can access this in both English and Hindi languages. Click on the appropriate language option.
Step 3- This will open the form in PDF format. Download it and get a printout.

Step 4- Fill the form manually with all your bank and personal data, including bank branch, name of town/village, block/district, Aadhaar number, profession, annual income, details of Kisan credit card, and others.
Step 5- Once you fill it out, visit your nearest bank branch and submit it.
While submitting the form, you will need to produce certain documents along with your Mobile number or email Id to qualify for the Jan Dhan Yojana.
